retailer.intro_text: Each button is cut, shaped and finished by hand in the workshop on Hindsholm.
retailer.form_romso_desc: The Romsø button is carved with a gentle taper at each end.
retailer.form_stavre_desc: Soft forms meet a clearly defined edge that frames the button along its length.
retailer.term_shipping_value: Free shipping over 500 DKK (DK). International shipping is arranged individually.
retailer.term_leadtime_value: Depends on order size and current stock. Most orders ship within a week.
retailer.craft_title: Your own shapes in small runs
retailer.craft_text: Everything is cut by hand with traditional tools. That means we can make your own shapes — even in very small runs. Write to us with an idea and we will work it out together.
retailer.craft_img_alt: Hands cutting a wooden button in the workshop
retailer.spec_note: Both forms are approx. 40 mm long. The holes are 3 mm in diameter — available with one or two holes, chosen when ordering.
